feature: official grpc-cpp ORCA out-of-band streaming reports

directions: netz client to official grpc-cpp server
official grpc-cpp client to netz server
scope.lifecycle: initial OOB snapshot, two interval-spaced updates beside a business duplex RPC, business OK, stream-local OOB cancellation

reference.implementation: grpc-core C++ OrcaService, OobBackendMetricWatcher, interop client and interop server

implementation.request_codec: owned OrcaLoadReportRequest with validated protobuf Duration and repeated request_cost_names
implementation.client: typed incremental reports own decoded protobuf and metric indexes, expose per-read timeout/deadline and RST_STREAM CANCEL
implementation.server: one-message request validation, typed report writes, flow-control resume, requested-cost filtering, and peer-reset observation
implementation.ownership_boundary: the reconnecting Channel remains single-operation; OOB and business streams are opened on one explicit connected HTTP/2 owner and progressed alternately
implementation.reverse_fixture: accepts OOB and business streams in either order, publishes an immediate snapshot and two one-second updates, then verifies business half-close and OOB cancellation
implementation.forward_fixture: skips the official server's initial empty snapshot, validates both periodic reports, finishes the business stream, and cancels only OOB

results.reverse_matrix: 27 scenarios per transport, 54 total, passed over h2c and TLS
results.reverse_oob: official grpc-cpp client accepted both netz OOB updates and completed the business RPC over h2c and TLS
results.forward_matrix: complete netz-client matrix passed over h2c and TLS, plus pick-first failover
results.forward_oob: netz owned both official periodic reports and canceled the OOB stream without disrupting the business RPC over h2c and TLS

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Dtest-filter='gRPC ORCA OOB' --summary all
remaining_gap: Canonical OOB wire behavior and lifecycle are externally covered. Automatic SharedChannel admission, report fan-out, and reconnect policy remain separate higher-level composition work.
